name: correlated-membership-column-affinity
sql: SELECT o.id,typeof(o.k) FROM typed_outer o WHERE o.k IN (SELECT i.k FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp) ORDER BY o.id;

name: correlated-membership-computed-left-collation
sql: SELECT o.id,typeof(o.k) FROM typed_outer o WHERE o.k||'' IN (SELECT i.k COLLATE NOCASE FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp) ORDER BY o.id;

name: correlated-not-in-computed-left-collation
sql: SELECT o.id,typeof(o.k) FROM typed_outer o WHERE o.k||'' NOT IN (SELECT i.k COLLATE NOCASE FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp) ORDER BY o.id;
